QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteBernstein.ba.literal: def basis (d r : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ := (bernsteinPolynomial ℝ d r).eval t

QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteBernstein.ca.literal: def casteljau (d : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (i : ℕ) : ℝ := (casteljauStep t ^ d) c i
QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteBernstein.ca.normalized: d iterations of the coefficient-row update c_i -> (1-t)c_i+t*c_(i+1), read at index i

QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteBernstein.le.literal: def leftRestriction (u : ℝ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (i : ℕ) : ℝ := casteljau i c u 0
QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteBernstein.le.normalized: left edge of the exact de Casteljau triangle

QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteBernstein.ri.literal: def rightRestriction (d : ℕ) (u : ℝ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (i : ℕ) : ℝ := leftRestriction (1-u) (fun r => c (d-r)) (d-i)
QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteBernstein.ri.normalized: right edge, with natural truncated subtraction and coefficient order reversal

QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteBernstein.re.literal: def restrictCoefficients (d : ℕ) (u v : ℝ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ := leftRestriction ((v-u)/(1-u)) (rightRestriction d u c)
QuantumBlockEncoding.HermiteBernstein.re.normalized: the two successive exact-real subdivisions at u and (v-u)/(1-u)
